root_cause_label: Ran out of steps before implementing solution
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent exhausted its entire 5-step budget on exploration and planning (including a wasteful task_tracker call) without ever writing a single line of implementation code, producing no data.comp output file.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 begins pure exploration (cat decomp.c) when the 5-step budget requires immediate implementation; any step not contributing directly to producing data.comp is a decisive mistake given the extremely limited budget.
t_commit_evidence: By step 4 the agent uses its 4th step on a task_tracker planning call instead of coding; with only 1 step remaining and no implementation started, failure is irreversibly locked in.
trigger_explanation: The agent appears unaware of its extremely limited 5-step budget and proceeds with a normal exploration-then-plan-then-implement strategy that would be reasonable in an unconstrained setting, but is fatal given only 5 total steps. It lacks awareness that it must skip standard exploration overhead and implement immediately.
